changes.title: Collect typed keys from the first key press; cut problem outlines to where their step is visible
changes.detail: A look at build 462 found the sidebar search kept every letter at human speed but still dropped all but the first in a fast burst: the keys arrived before the dialog had even loaded, so nobody was home to catch them. Collecting now starts in the same turn as the first key, in a small shared module, and the dialog takes the text when its field has focus. It lets go of the keyboard by itself after six seconds if no dialog ever asks. Problem outlines followed their step out of its scrolling container and, on a wide window, were drawn over the page footer. They are now cut to the area the step can actually be seen in, across shadow roots, and a sliver too small to read is not outlined. HANDOFF.md records builds 457 and 462, the update feed change, the change list, the Updates page and the updates log.
changes.detail_yue: 睇返 462 版，側欄搜尋慢慢打係齊字，但係一輪嘴咁快打就得返第一個字： 啲字到咗，個對話框仲未開門，冇人接。而家第一下撳掣嗰刻就開始接字， 等對話框攞到焦點先交返，六秒冇人嚟攞就自己收工。另外問題外框以前會 跟住個步驟捲出界，闊螢幕仲會畫咗落頁腳度；而家只會畫喺睇得見嘅範圍， 剩得一條線咁窄就乾脆唔畫。

changes.title: Add build progress and a version comparison to the Updates page
changes.detail: The Updates page could say "Everything is up to date" and nothing else, like a station board that only ever shows "On time". It now has an "Update coming soon" card that reads the public build runs: build number, the Core version it becomes, a progress bar over the jobs, the stage in words, a labelled estimate, every job with its state, and plain messages when a build fails, is replaced, or the public list cannot be reached. Below it, "What changed between versions" compares any two builds from the published change list: a side-by-side table, counts per part of the product that act as filters, a search with the pattern builder, and the changes grouped by build with the explanation in the reader's language mode. Both read public pages from the browser only; nothing about the home is sent. Logic is covered by tests; the page has not been seen in a built app yet.
changes.detail_yue: 更新頁以前淨係識講「全部都係最新」，好似個車站顯示屏永遠得「準時」 兩個字。而家多咗張「更新就嚟到」卡：邊個版本、去到邊個階段、進度條、 估計時間、每個工序嘅狀態都睇到，砌唔成或者畀新版頂替咗都會老實講。 下面仲可以揀任何兩個版本嚟比較，分部分篩選、搜尋，解釋跟返你揀嘅 語言。全部只係讀公開頁面，屋企嘅資料一啲都唔會送出去。

changes.title: Add the Updates design canvas and publish a change list with the update feed
changes.detail: Installed homes could see a version number and nothing about what it contained, like a parcel with a tracking code and no label. The feed publisher now also writes changes.json: every build with the commits since the build before it, the part of the product each one touched, and the explanation in English and Cantonese, rebuilt from history on each run so it needs no previous copy. A failure there never holds back the feed. Design canvas 33 holds four boards for the Updates page: the "Update coming soon" card with its progress bar, every state of that card, and the comparison of two versions on a wide window and a phone.
changes.detail_yue: 以前部機淨係見到個版本號，入面有乜完全唔知，好似收到個包裹淨係得張 追蹤編號。而家更新名單會跟埋一份改動清單：每個版本改咗啲乜、改邊個 部分、中英文解釋都有，每次由歷史重新砌，壞咗都唔會阻住更新名單。 設計畫布 33 有四塊板：「更新就嚟到」進度卡、佢嘅所有狀態，同埋闊螢幕 同手機嘅版本比較。
